data.title: Bitcoin And Ethereum Edge Higher As Traders Watch Altcoin Rotation
data.description: Bitcoin and Ethereum edged higher into July 31, while a small shift in market dominance suggested traders were again watching whether capital was rotating toward major altcoins.The validated notes show Bitcoin rising 0.29% to about $64,145.86, while Ethereum traded around the $1,890 to $1,920 range…
